{{Top|leg}}
The '''micro-processing module''' was a revolution in [[Droid/Legends|droid]] engineering that allowed [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] to store sets of navigational data. This allowed the droids to function as navigational [[Computer/Legends|computers]].
